explanation: BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa) is an economic grouping of major emerging economies, later expanded to include additional members — distinct from SAARC (a South Asian regional grouping) or ASEAN (Southeast Asian nations).

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The regional organisation comprising India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, and Afghanistan, formed to promote economic and regional cooperation among South Asian nations, is known by the acronym:

options.option_text: SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation)

explanation: SAARC, founded in 1985 and headquartered in Kathmandu, groups South Asian nations for regional cooperation — distinct from BRICS (major emerging economies globally) or ASEAN (Southeast Asian nations).
